ai_async_queue_max_jobs.valve: Limit on number of jobs that will be run(serially) in a frame. - 1 = no limit

ai_gather_conditions_async.valve: Allow gathering of conditions to be done asynchronously.

ai_think_interval_lod_low.valve: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD low.

ai_think_interval_lod_med.valve: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD medium.

ai_think_interval_lod_very_low.valve: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD very low.

anim_decode_forcewritealltransforms.valve: Force BatchAnimationDecode to write transformations for all bones

anim_resource_validate_on_load.valve: Validates the animation group channel list against the animations on load for every animation

animgraph_footlock_auto_ledge_detection.valve: Attempt to detect when the foot is partially hanging off a ledge and stop it tilting to reach the bottom

animgraph_footlock_auto_stair_detection.valve: Attempt to detect when the foot is on a stair and will stop it from tilting to reach the next step

animgraph_footlock_enabled.valve: A master convar that effectively disables the entire footlock node.

animgraph_footlock_trace_ground_enabled.valve: Convar for toggling foot lock ground tracking.

audio_enable_spawn_mask_mix_layer.valve: Enables the mix layer which mutes certain sounds at map load boundaries.

audio_enclosure_calc_enabled.valve: Enables/disabled calculations that determine entity interior vs exterior.

cam_idealdelta.valve: Controls the speed when matching offset to ideal angles in thirdperson view

cam_ideallag.valve: Amount of lag used when matching offset to ideal angles in thirdperson view

cc_captiontrace.valve: Show missing closecaptions (0 = no, 1 = devconsole, 2 = show in hud)

citadel_boss_glow_disabled.note: Turns off the glow on bosses and objectives.

citadel_camera_height.valve: The look at point of the camera is vertically offset by this distance.

citadel_camera_hero_fov.valve: The field of view angle of the camera when following a hero.
citadel_camera_hero_fov.note: Field of view for the hero camera.

citadel_camera_see_distance_max.valve: Max Distance the camera can 'see' an entity

citadel_camera_soft_collision.valve: Soften the camera to wall collision distance by using the gaussian weight of fibbonnaci cone of line traces. 2: Use soft collision system to inform hole punch.

citadel_camera_soft_collision_angle.valve: Soft camera collision cone arc angle in degrees. Larger cone angle results in earlier softening.

citadel_camera_use_vmdl_flatten_horizont.valve: For each camera pose set, use the average of X positions. This is a motion sickness reducing action.

citadel_camera_use_vmdl_flatten_vertical.valve: Zero the relative Z axis of the camera to reduce motion sickness.

citadel_cinematic_intro_duration_npc.valve: How long is the cinematic intro applied to npcs (shrine/patron)

citadel_cinematic_intro_duration_player.valve: How long is the cinematic intro applied to the player

citadel_cinematic_intro_enabled.note: Plays the short intro camera at the start of a match.

citadel_commend_toast_enemy_seconds.valve: Number of seconds to show enemy commend toasts

citadel_commend_toast_seconds.valve: Number of seconds to show commend toasts

citadel_custom_ui_colors.valve: Enable colorblind-friendly colors and the player's custom UI colors.

citadel_damage_text_lifetime_new.valve: How long do accumulated numbers live.

citadel_damage_text_show_effectiveness.valve: Show the damage effectiveness on every damage number

citadel_death_ragdoll_duration.valve: How long a dead hero's ragdoll exists for before it despawns. Can outlive the death camera ( citadel_death_return_to_spawn_delay ) so that other players still see the body.
citadel_death_ragdoll_duration.note: How long dead heroes stay on the ground.

citadel_enemy_visible_upon_reveal_durati.valve: How long an enemy appears through walls (outline or ui icon) after taking damage. Must also have fog of war visibility.

citadel_fibonnaci_sphere_trace_los_max.valve: How big to cap the size of the sphere when checking for really large explosion/effects

citadel_hideout_ball_show_juggle_count.valve: WIP Show juggle count on ball.

citadel_hideout_ball_show_juggle_fx.valve: WIP Show fx when hitting apex/landing on floor.

citadel_hud_objective_health_enabled.valve: Enable/Disable HUD-level objective health bars.  0=Off. 1=Shrines, Patron, Midboss. 2=T1s and T2s. 3=Barracks

citadel_hud_objective_health_idle_timeou.valve: After how many seconds of an objective is damage to hide its health on the HUD

citadel_melee_shake_amplitude.note: Strength of the screen shake on melee hits.

citadel_orb_debug_draw_state.valve: Set to non-zero to draw state of orb. Value will be duration for state to linger after orb expires.

citadel_player_model_force_highest_lod.valve: Forces the local player pawn to render using the highest LOD level.
citadel_player_model_force_highest_lod.note: Always draws heroes at full detail, even far away. Slower.

citadel_shoot_forward_offset.valve: How far forward from the plane of hero and camera forward to move the shoot position

citadel_show_old_neutral_camp_icons.valve: Show the old neutral camp icons on the minimap

citadel_show_survey.valve: A way to force the survey UI on even outside of matchmaking

citadel_trooper_friendly_glow_disabled.valve: Disable glow on friendly troopers except for through walls during laning

citadel_trooper_glow_disabled.note: Turns off the glow on troopers.

citadel_use_spectator_team_colors.valve: Forces HUD and game to draw team colors as if you are a spectator

citadel_world_bullet_impacts_for_npcs.valve: Turns on bullet impacts and decals on world from troopers and neutrals shooting

cl_batch_entity_list_ops_during_latch.valve: Batch entity list adds / removes while latching interpolated variables to avoid mutex contention.

cl_clock_buffer_ticks.valve: Clock sync will try to maintain an additional margin of N ticks.  This is intended to smooth over packet loss, and is a replacement for cl_interp_ratio / cl_interp.  This value is simply added to cl_clock_recvmargin_desired

cl_disable_ragdolls.note: Turns off ragdoll physics for dead units.

cl_disconnect_soundevent.valve: This soundevent is called to stop the desired soundevents when the game is disconnected.

cl_hud_telemetry_frametime_show.valve: Show frame time (FPS) in the HUD.  0=never, 1=only if poor, 2=always

cl_interp_parallel.valve: Run interpolation in parallel for entities with no children.

cl_interp_ratio.valve: Sets the client simulation interpolation amount, in terms of server updates (final amount is cl_interp_ratio / cl_updaterate).
cl_interp_ratio.note: Network interpolation buffer, in ticks. Lower shows enemies more up to date but can stutter on bad connections.

cl_parallel_readpacketentities.valve: Set to 1 to use threading snapshot reading (if game supports and server is sending bitcounts).

cl_parallel_readpacketentities_threshold.valve: Use parallel processing of snapshot reading if above this many entries.

cl_particle_fallback_base.valve: Base for falling back to cheaper effects under load.

cl_particle_fallback_multiplier.valve: Multiplier for falling back to cheaper effects under load.

cl_particle_max_count.note: Maximum number of particles alive at once.

cl_particle_sim_fallback_base_multiplier.valve: How aggressive the switch to fallbacks will be depending on how far over the cl_particle_sim_fallback_threshold_ms the sim time is.  Higher numbers are more aggressive.

cl_particle_sim_fallback_threshold_ms.valve: Amount of simulation time that can elapse before new systems start falling back to cheaper versions

cl_phys_assume_fixed_tick_interval.valve: If true, we assume the client uses a fixed tickrate like the server (which may not always be true). If false, we recalculate the number of physics substeps in each client tick based on the actual elapsed time in the tick.

cl_phys_sleep_enable.valve: Enable sleeping for dynamic physics bodies.

cl_poll_network_early.valve: Enable polling for network messages every frame, instead of every tick

cl_pred_optimize.valve: Optimize for not repredicting if there were no errors

cl_prediction_savedata_postentitypacketr.valve: Experimental optimization.  If you are reading this in 2026, please delete this convar.

cl_ragdoll_limit.valve: Maximum number of ragdolls to show (-1 disables limit)
cl_ragdoll_limit.note: Maximum number of ragdolls at once.

cl_resend.valve: Delay in seconds before the client will resend the 'connect' attempt

cl_retire_low_priority_lights.valve: Low priority dlights are replaced by high priority ones

cl_skip_hierarchy_update_for_unchanged_e.valve: Skip updating hierarchy information in PostDataUpdate for entities that have not changed

cl_smooth.valve: Smooth view/eye origin after prediction errors

cl_smoothtime.valve: Smooth client's view after prediction error over this many seconds

cl_tickpacket_desired_queuelength.valve: This value, multiplied by the tick interval, is added to cl_tickpacket_recvmargin_desired to obtain the effective desired recv margin.

cl_tickpacket_recvmargin_desired.valve: Recvmargin-based usercommand pacing will try to maintain N ms margin between user command arriving at the server and the server needing that user command.  See also cl_tickpacket_desired_queuelength.

cl_updaterate.valve: Number of packets per second of updates you are requesting from the server
cl_updaterate.note: Snapshots per second requested from the server.

cl_usesocketsforloopback.valve: When connecting to local listen server (for example, using the 'map' command), default to loopback=false, which connects to '127.0.0.1' instead of 'loopback'.  This uses the network stack so that fake lag/loss can be simulated.

cloth_filter_transform_stateless.valve: Enable the new, stateless version of FilterTransform

con_enable.valve: Allows the console to be activated.

cpu_level.note: Overall CPU detail level used by the engine (0 low, 1 medium, 2 high).

cq_buffer_bloat_msecs_max.valve: Server will not allow the client to buffer up more than N ms of commands.

csm_max_num_cascades_override.valve: Number of cascades in sunlight shadow
csm_max_num_cascades_override.note: Number of sun shadow cascades. Fewer is faster; far shadows get worse.

csm_max_visible_dist.note: How far away sun shadows are drawn.

csm_viewmodel_shadows.note: Shadows on your own weapon and arms.

disable_source_soundscape_trace.valve: Bypasses lookup of soundscapes for indvidual audio sources when enabled.

engine_accurate_input_processing_delta_t.valve: When true, elapsed time given to the input processing will be the time elapsed since the last input processing. This is only relevant when input is processed multiple times per frame ( i.e. multiple ticks per frame)

engine_allow_multiple_simulates_per_fram.valve: When the client is catching up in low frame rate situations, should we run client simulate more than once a frame?

engine_low_latency_sleep_after_client_ti.valve: When r_low_latency is enabled, this moves the low latency sleep on tick frames to happen after client simulation.

engine_max_ticks_to_simulate.valve: Max number of ticks to simulate per frame, after which simulation will start to slow down compared to real time.

engine_no_focus_sleep.note: How long the game sleeps per frame while it's in the background (milliseconds). Higher saves power when alt-tabbed.

fps_max.valve: Frame rate limiter.  0=no limit.  Does not apply to dedicated server.
fps_max.note: Frame rate cap in matches. 0 means no cap.

fps_max_tools.valve: Additional frame rate limit while in tools mode and a window other than the game window has focus. Note that fps_max still applies, this only allows the maximum frame rate for tools mode to be lower. 0=no tools specific limit.

fps_max_ui.valve: Frame rate limiter while the game UI is displayed.  0=no limit.  Does not apply to dedicated server.

fs_async_threads.valve: Number of IO threads in async filesystem (-1 == auto)

gpu_level.note: Overall GPU detail level used by the engine.

in_button_double_press_window.valve: How short the time between presses needs to be for us to consider it a double-press

lb_barnlight_shadowmap_scale.valve: Scale for computed barnlight shadowmap size

lb_csm_cascade_size_override.valve: Override width/height of individual cascades in the CSM

lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades.valve: Override Cascades that will render static objects with lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades_value

lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades_anima.valve: If lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades, ensure only objects without animated verts, i.e. SCENEOBJECTFLAG_CAN_RENDER_INTO_SST flag will be excluded (as opposed to all static objects).

lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades_value.valve: If lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades, override value used to determine which cascades render static objects

lb_csm_receiver_plane_depth_bias.valve: Shader depth bias applied to shadow receiver (Note this conflicts with renderstate depth bias, both now default to 0)

lb_csm_receiver_plane_depth_bias_transmi.valve: Depth bias applied to shadow receiver for transmissive backface geo (based on renderstate depthbias being 0)

lb_cull_offscreen_bounce_light_shadows.valve: Skip shadowmaps for offscreen dynamic bounce lights that indirect diffuse isn't going to sample

lb_cull_onscreen_bounce_light_shadows.valve: Skip shadowmaps for *onscreen* dynamic bounce lights which will probably not be visible

lb_debug_silhouette_sum.valve: If we should draw normal silhouette or minkowski sum silhouette

lb_debug_visualize_precomputed_shadow_at.valve: SceneSystem/LightBinner/Debug Visualize Precomputed Shadow Atlas Lights

lb_dynamic_shadow_penumbra.valve: Adjust shadow penumbra based on light size

lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution.note: Lets shadow resolution change with distance.

lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution_base.valve: Base resolution for dynamic shadowmap sizing.  Shadowmap size of a screen sized light

lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution_base_cmp_sh.valve: take min of lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution and barnlight shadowmapsize as base shadowmapsize

lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution_quantizatio.valve: Quantization of dynamically computed shadow size

lb_enable_shadow_casting.valve: Allow stationary/dynamic lights to cast shadows.
lb_enable_shadow_casting.note: Shadows from lights other than the sun. Off is much faster.

lb_shadow_map_cull_empty_mixed.valve: Don't render shadows for mixed shadowmaps with no dynamics objects in view

lb_shadow_texture_height_override.valve: Override height of shadow atlas texture

lb_shadow_texture_width_override.valve: Override width of shadow atlas texture

lb_sun_csm_size_cull_threshold_texels.valve: Size, in texels, where we will cull an object in the shadowmap

lb_use_illumination_volume.valve: Disables use of illumination volume (may cause precomputed lighting errors)

mat_colorcorrection.note: Map colour grading. Off shows plain colours.

mat_viewportscale.valve: Scale down the main viewport (to reduce GPU impact on CPU profiling)
mat_viewportscale.note: Render scale. Below 1 renders fewer pixels for more FPS and a blurrier image.

mm_idle_enabled.valve: Kill switch for the idle detection system

mm_idle_show_warning_at_s.valve: How many seconds to wait before showing the idle warning dialog

mm_prefer_solo_only.valve: Prefer being matched with other solo players when not in a party

net_gather_child_fields_only.valve: GatherSendProxyResults only walks struct and array fields, skipping scalar fields.

panorama_async_compute_mipgen.valve: use asynchronous compute for mipmap generation.

panorama_disable_blur.note: Turns off blur behind menus and HUD panels. Faster.

panorama_disable_box_shadow.note: Turns off shadows on menu and HUD panels. Faster.

panorama_js_minidumps.valve: Enable sending minidumps on JS Exceptions.

panorama_script_cache_enabled.valve: Enable script caching to speed up recompiling scripts multiple times.

panorama_transition_time_factor.valve: A float representing a scale factor for transitions. 1.0 is normal, 2.0 would be twice as fast as normal, 0.5 half as fast

props_break_max_pieces_perframe.valve: Maximum prop breakable piece count per frame (-1 = model default)

r_aoproxy_cull_dist.valve: Distance to cull the AO proxy as a factor of size

r_aspectratio.note: Forces an aspect ratio, e.g. for stretched resolutions. 0 uses the screen's.

r_bloom_tent_filter_radius.valve: bloom mip up-sample filtering radius (using 3x3 tent filter, radius in mip level texels), 0.0 radius => box (2x2) filter with (fixed) 1.0 radius

r_citadel_antialiasing.note: Anti-aliasing mode. Off is sharper and faster but shows jagged edges.

r_citadel_depthoffield_aperture_diameter.valve: Depth of field aperture diameter in inches

r_citadel_depthoffield_debug.valve: Enable depth of field debug drawing

r_citadel_depthoffield_focus_distance.valve: Depth of field focus distance in inches

r_citadel_depthoffield_mode.valve: Depth of field mode, 0: Normal 1: Near field only 2: Far field only

r_citadel_depthoffield_sensor_size.valve: Depth of field sensor size in inches

r_citadel_disable_particle_lights.valve: Disable particle lights except when explicitly overriden in particle renderer ops.
r_citadel_disable_particle_lights.note: Stops particle effects from casting light. Saves GPU time in fights.

r_citadel_distancefield_ao_quality.note: Quality of large-scale ambient occlusion from distance fields. Lower is faster.

r_citadel_distancefield_farfield_occlusi.valve: Distance field far field occlusion length
Distance field far field occlusion start offset

r_citadel_distancefield_min_screen_space.valve: Minimum screen space size before culling

r_citadel_distancefield_ray_origin_bias_.valve: Distance field ray origin bias max
Distance field ray origin bias min

r_citadel_distancefield_shadows.note: Soft shadows from distance fields. Off is faster.

r_citadel_drop_shadow_flare.valve: Percentage the shadow grows in each dimension per 100 game units below the character's feet.

r_citadel_fog_quality.note: Volumetric fog quality. Lower is faster.

r_citadel_fsr_enable_mip_bias.valve: Apply negative mip bias when rendering with FSR.

r_citadel_npr_outlines_max_dist.valve: Maximum distance at which NPR outlines are rendered

r_citadel_render_game.valve: Should you render the main game world

r_citadel_selection_outline2_offset.valve: Selection Outline Offset: -1 for interior, 0 for centered, 1 for exterior.

r_citadel_shadow_quality.note: Shadow quality. Lower is faster and blurrier.

r_citadel_ssao_quality.note: Ambient occlusion quality. Lower is faster.

r_citadel_upscaling.note: Upscaling mode (FSR/DLSS). Renders at a lower resolution and scales up for more FPS.

r_decals.note: Maximum number of decals kept in the world. Lower is faster.

r_depth_of_field.note: Blur on far or near objects. Off keeps the whole screen sharp.

r_draw3dskybox.note: Draws the distant 3D sky scenery. Off is faster.

r_draw_particle_children_with_parents.valve: Draw particle children with parents (-1=use gameinfo, 0=no, 1=yes)

r_drawdecals.note: Bullet holes, scorch marks and other decals. Off is faster.

r_drawropes.note: Draws ropes and cables in the map.

r_drawtracers_firstperson.valve: Toggle visibility of first person weapon tracers
r_drawtracers_firstperson.note: Bullet tracers for your own shots.

r_drawviewmodel.note: Draws your own weapon and arms.

r_effects_bloom.note: Glow around bright light. Off is a bit faster and clearer.

r_environment_map_roughness_range.valve: Fade region for sampling environment maps on lightmapped nonmetals. Smoother values than the first param sample envmaps. Rougher values than the second sample only lightmap SH. r_environment_map_roughness_range 1 1 to always sample envmaps for comparison.

r_fallback_texture_lod_scale.valve: Scale factor for requested texture size (texture streaming) - used for geo that doesn't have a precomputed UV density measure

r_farz.valve: Override the far clipping plane. -1 means to use the value in env_fog_controller.
r_farz.note: Far clipping distance. Things beyond it aren't drawn.

r_grass_density_mode.valve: 0 = Density corresponds to blade existance, 1 = Density corresponds to blade height, 2 = Both 0 and 1

r_lightmap_size_directional_irradiance.valve: Maximum lightmap resolution for directional_irradiance channel. -1 = use value of r_lightmap_size

r_low_latency.valve: NVIDIA Low Latency/AMD Anti-Lag 2 (0 = off, 1 = on, 2 = NV-only, on + boost)
r_low_latency.note: NVIDIA Reflex / low-latency mode. Lowers input lag; 0 turns it off.

r_mapextents.valve: Set the max dimension for the map.  This determines the far clipping plane

r_nearz.valve: Override the near clipping plane. -1 means use the default.

r_particle_fixedrandomseeds.valve: Use fixed seeds for easier debugging

r_particle_max_detail_level.valve: The maximum detail level of particle to create
r_particle_max_detail_level.note: Highest particle detail. Lower makes ability effects simpler and faster.

r_particle_max_draw_distance.valve: The maximum distance that particles will render
r_particle_max_draw_distance.note: How far away particles are still drawn.

r_particle_max_size_cull.valve: Particle systems larger than this in every dimension skip culling to save CPU.  They will be drawn anyway.

r_particle_min_timestep.valve: A minimum on particle simulation time, particle simulation happening more frequently than this will lerp.

r_particle_multiplier.valve: Render each particle system N times for perf testing

r_particle_newinput.valve: Enable input path in particle ops

r_pipeline_stats_use_flush_api.valve: Experimental: Set to 1 to use the ID3D11DeviceContext11::Flush() to flush the GPU pipeline instead of queries.

r_post_bloom.note: Glow around bright light in post-processing. Off is a bit faster and clearer.

r_propsmaxdist.note: How far away props are still drawn.

r_renderdoc_auto_shader_pdbs.valve: Automatically generate shader debug info on capture

r_rendersun.note: Draws the sun disc and its glow.

r_size_cull_threshold.valve: Threshold of screen size percentage below which objects get culled

r_size_cull_threshold_fade.valve: % above the screen size percentage where we will start fading out (==0 will disable fading).

r_size_cull_threshold_shadow.valve: Threshold of shadow map size percentage below which objects get culled

r_ssao.valve: Set to use screen-space ambient occlusion
r_ssao.note: Ambient occlusion (soft contact shadows). Off gives more FPS and flatter-looking scenes.

r_ssao_strength.note: How dark ambient occlusion shadows are.

r_texture_budget_dynamic.valve: Dynamically adjust texture streaming budget based on GPU memory usage.

r_texture_budget_threshold.valve: Reduce texture memory pool size when this percentage of the budget is full.

r_texture_budget_update_period.valve: Time (in seconds) between updating texture memory budget.

r_texture_lod_scale.valve: Scale factor for requested texture size (texture streaming)

r_texture_nonstreaming_load.valve: Allow immediately loading mips of textures (when possible) when their headers are loaded, saving IO & reducing latency.

r_texture_pool_reduce_rate.valve: Reduce texture memory pool size by this many MB / s when over budget.

r_texture_pool_size.valve: Total size of the texture pool in MB

r_texture_stream_max_resolution.valve: Maximum resolution for top mip level in streaming textures
r_texture_stream_max_resolution.note: Largest texture size loaded. Lower uses less VRAM and looks blurrier.

r_texture_stream_mip_bias.valve: Biases the mip level the texture streaming system choses to stream for each texture.
r_texture_stream_mip_bias.note: Shifts textures toward lower detail levels. Higher uses less VRAM and looks blurrier.

r_texturefilteringquality.valve: 0: Bilinear, 1: Trilinear, 2: Aniso 2x, 3: Aniso 4x, 4: Aniso 8x, 5: Aniso 16x
r_texturefilteringquality.note: Texture filtering (anisotropic). Higher keeps far surfaces sharp at a small GPU cost.

reset_voice_on_input_stallout.valve: If true, resets the input device when there was a long enough hitch between callbacks.

rope_smooth_enlarge.valve: How much to enlarge ropes in screen space for antialiasing effect

rope_smooth_minwidth.valve: When using smoothing, this is the min screenspace width it lets a rope shrink to

rope_wind_dist.valve: Don't use CPU applying small wind gusts to ropes when they're past this distance.

rtx_dynamic_blas.valve: Allow dynamic BLAS creation for geometry going through the compute shader skinning path.

rtx_dynamic_blas_caching.valve: Cache dynamic BLAS if geometry has not changed

rtx_force_default_hitgroup.valve: Forces all ray traced geometry to use default hit shaders instead of specialized ones.

rtx_texture_resolution.valve: Sets the texture resolution the raytracer will mark to stream in

sc_aggregate_gpu_culling.valve: Toggles GPU culling of aggregate meshes

sc_allow_dithered_lod.valve: Allow use of dithered lod transitions

sc_barnlight_enable_precomputed_vis.valve: Enable use of precomputed vis membership for lights (requires map restart)

sc_clutter_density_full_size.valve: Screen-size where clutter will be full density

sc_clutter_density_none_size.valve: Screen-size where clutter will be gone

sc_dithered_lod_transition_amt.valve: Percentage of the transition between two lods we will apply a dither

sc_force_translation_in_projection.valve: If enabled, the camera's translation will be included in the projection matrix.

sc_hdr_enabled_override.valve: Override default setting for HDR rendering. -1 default, 0 NoHdr, 1 Hdr, 2 Hdr 1010102 3 Hdr 111110

sc_instanced_mesh_gpu_culling.valve: Toggles GPU culling of instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_lod_bias.valve: Bias for LOD selection of instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_lod_bias_shadow.valve: Bias for LOD selection of instanced meshes in shadowmaps

sc_instanced_mesh_motion_vectors.valve: Toggles motion vector support for instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_opaque_fade.valve: Toggles fade support for instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_shadows_batch_across_m.valve: Toggles whether mesh shader instanced can batch on reflectivity

sc_instanced_mesh_size_cull_bias.valve: Bias for size culling of instanced meshes

sc_instanced_mesh_size_cull_bias_shadow.valve: Bias for size culling instanced meshes in shadowmaps

sc_screen_size_lod_scale_override.note: Level-of-detail scale. Higher switches models to simpler versions sooner.

shake_show.valve: Displays a list of the active screen shakes.

skeleton_instance_lod_optimization.valve: Compute LOD mask internally like since 2016, i.e. force all LOD groups' bones to compute

snd_boxverb_simd.valve: Enable SIMD code path for shoebox reverb processor.

snd_mixahead.note: Audio buffer length in seconds. Lower reduces sound delay; too low can crackle.

snd_steamaudio_baked_dimensions_probeloo.valve: Use alternate probe lookup algorithm to query dimensions for listener position based on kd-tree of probe points.

snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_out.valve: Enable baking outside field for probes baking custom dimensions data.

snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_siz.valve: Enable baking size and inout data for probes when baking custom dimensions data.

snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_sma.valve: Enable baking insize size field for probes when baking custom dimensions data.

snd_steamaudio_dimensions_grid_height_ma.valve: The maximum height (from the ground) we allow probes to be added above the initial layer. (meters)

snd_steamaudio_dimensions_max_ray_length.valve: 0 is disabled, but otherwise sets a limit the maximum ray size in the dimension size calculation. Used to model the enclosure algorithm. Game units

snd_steamaudio_enable_editor_profiling.valve: Enables tracy profiling when baking steam audio data in Hammer.

snd_steamaudio_enable_occlusion_caching.valve: Continue using previous occlusion if probe lookup for occlusion fails.

snd_steamaudio_enable_pathing.valve: This variable is checked by soundstack to globally enabling pathing for audio processing.
snd_steamaudio_enable_pathing.note: Steam Audio sound paths around corners. Off is cheaper on the CPU.

snd_steamaudio_enable_reverb.note: Steam Audio reverb. Off is cheaper on the CPU.

snd_steamaudio_invalid_path_length.valve: Path length of invalid path in inches. Set this to .0 to use direct distance as path length.

snd_steamaudio_ir_duration.valve: The time delay between a sound being emitted and the last audible reflection in Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_load_dimensions_data.valve: If set, baked dimensions data is loaded.

snd_steamaudio_load_materials_data.valve: If set, baked materials data is loaded.

snd_steamaudio_load_occlusion_data.valve: If set, baked occlusion data is loaded.

snd_steamaudio_load_pathing_data.valve: If set, baked pathing data is loaded. Steam Audio Hammer entities can successfully use pathing in this case.

snd_steamaudio_load_reverb_data.valve: If set, baked reverb data is loaded. Reset it to zero during an format changes of baked data until all data is updated.

snd_steamaudio_max_occlusion_samples.valve: The maximum number of rays that can be traced for volumetric occlusion by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_max_probes_customdata_dim.valve: Maximum number of probes to create when baking custom data (dimensions).

snd_steamaudio_num_diffuse_samples.valve: The number of directions considered for ray bounce by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_num_threads.valve: Sets the number of threads used for realtime reflection by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_pathing_order.valve: The amount of directional detail in the simulated by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_pathing_order_rendering.valve: The amount of directional detail in the rendered audio by Steam Audio.

snd_steamaudio_reverb_level_db.valve: Adjust overall volume (dB) of the output from Steam Audio Reverb processor.

snd_steamaudio_reverb_order_rendering.valve: Ambisonics order to use for convolution reverb. 0th order = 1 channel, 1st order = 4 channels.

snd_steamaudio_reverb_update_rate.valve: Set the maximum update rate (in Hz) for reverb.

sparseshadowtree_cs_exclude_next_cascade.valve: Exclude the inner region of a cascade during CS unpack if there is a higher resolution cascade that will cover that area.

sparseshadowtree_disable_add_layers.valve: Disable SST runtime layers, for debugging (will exclude geo that CAN render into SST if SST otherwise enabled)

sparseshadowtree_disable_for_viewmodel.valve: Disable SST generation and runtime for viewmodel (use original CSM rendering).

sparseshadowtree_enable_rendering.valve: Enable use of SST at runtime (static geo rendered into cascades via SST).

sparseshadowtree_leaf_precision_viewmode.valve: (viewmodel) precision for depth compression at SST leaf nodes.

sparseshadowtree_parallel_generation.valve: Split SST tile generation into threadjobs (0 - disabled, 1 - wait on readpixels for job batch, 2 - async readpixels).

stats_collect_gpu.valve: While doing stats_display, collect GPU perf counters. Used for stats_print_gpu.

sv_enable_donttransmit.valve: When encoding entity deltas, instead of unreliably deducing explicit deletions, actually send list of existing but not networked entities (dont_transmit list) to each client.

sv_frame_perf_sample_buffer_max.valve: Same as cl_frame_perf_sample_buffer_max, but for dedicated servers only.

sv_lagcomp_filterbyviewangle.valve: If true, player pawn will filter lag compensation targets by their view angle.

sv_maxunlag_player.valve: If >0, maximumum lag compensation used for other human pawns. Applied after sv_maxunlag!

sv_maxupdaterate.valve: Maximum updates per second that the server will allow

sv_maxvelocity.valve: Maximum speed any ballistically moving object is allowed to attain per axis.

sv_minrate.valve: Min bandwidth rate allowed on server, 0 == unlimited

sv_minupdaterate.valve: Minimum updates per second that the server will allow

sv_parallel_checktransmit.valve: Set to 1 to use threaded checkentities for transmit/pvs on listen servers, 2 for dedicated servers.

sv_parallel_sendsnapshot.valve: 0: run all send jobs on main thread; 1: send jobs run asynchronously (except on dedicated server); 2: send jobs asynchronously; 3: send jobs run in parallel but block to not overlap the next tick; 4: main server clients' send jobs run in parallel, then HLTV server jobs; this approximately matches pre-async profile for a single HLTV server configuration

sv_pvs_max_distance.valve: if set, adds a maximum range to PVS/PAS checks

sv_waterdist.valve: Vertical view fixup when eyes are near water plane.

think_limit.valve: Maximum think time in milliseconds, warning is printed if this is exceeded.

thread_pool_option.note: How many worker threads the engine uses.

tv_enable_delta_frames.valve: Indicates whether or not the tv should use delta frames for storage of intermediate frames. This takes more CPU but significantly less memory.

v8_maximum_heap_size_mb.valve: Hard limit for the v8 heap size (in mBytes)

viewmodel_fov.note: Field of view of your weapon and arms.

vis_sunlight_enable.valve: Toggle whether to use sunlight PVS for sunlight views (0 = sky PVS, 1 = sunlight PVS)

voice_input_stallout.valve: Time before we consider a mic stalled out and need to reset it.

zipline_use_new_latch.valve: Use the new latch motion for getting on a zipline. 0: Dont use 1: Just those with b_UseNewZipLineSetup 2: Everyone use
